name: Macaron
body:
Station and Complexity patissier 6

Flavor Profiles texture, sweet, texture, temperature, sweet, texture
Additional Ingredients sour, spicy, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 2d6
Saving Throw Will negates

DESCRIPTION

A macaron is a sweet confection made of egg white, a variety of sugars, and almonds blended in an elegant balance that only the most skilled culinarians can achieve.

When consumed, it grants spell resistance equal to 6 + the culinarian’s level for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each and the spell resistance by +2 each.
